title: AMAZING!
text: It was a birthday gift for my mother and could not have been better! Alfonso and Lorenzo were very accommodating, attentive, funny and super friendly! We had an amazing time and this class is definitely worth its money! :)
author: mirileadisque

title: Fun class, and tasty, too!
text: My husband and I loved learning how to make Sangrias (the right way!) and tapas.  The recipes were easy and I think we can recreate them at home.
author: jayneb326

title: Great class and recipes! I learned a lot!
text: I’m so glad my husband and I took this Tapas and Sangria class!  We learned new techniques and plan to make some of the recipes for our friends!
author: Dream21199863986

title: 10/10 - can't recommend enough!!
text: Words cannot describe how lovely and amazing this class was! Gabriel was great and explained everything so well. The variety of tapas was amazing, and it was very hands-on! It was so much fun for both young and old, and I would recommend it to everyone who wants to learn about Spanish food traditions for a really good price. I will definitely be coming back and can highly recommend it! Thanks so much to Gabriel and his team!
author: 375sofiaw

title: Tapas and Sangria
text: We had a great time at the tapas and sangria workshop. It was a ton of fun, met some great people, and the food and drinks were plentiful and delicious!! Highly recommend for a fun afternoon in Barcelona. Thanks for the warm hospitality.
author: Jennifer0blakely

title: Fun class!
text: Mateo and Alberto were very good. I had a nice time. The class was perfect for my expectations - not terribly challenging but we got to try all the techniques and learned some new skills.
author: Darla_S

title: Great value,experience, and good food!
text: We had delicious white Sangria which we made together. Something I can replicate on my own. The cooking part was fun and we all were able to participate.
author: Roxanne B

title: Amazing experience - would do it again!
text: Amazing experience with people from all around the world, all gathered around cooking, sangria and incredible chefs!
author: 703cleml

title: Fun and delicious!
text: We had a fantastic time with Matteo! He was so entertaining and enthusiastic- it made the whole experience a blast! The tapas were outstanding and the sangria we were able to make to meet our individual tastes. I would highly recommend this- be sure to go hungry! YUM! Thank you Matteo!
author: terrag2026

title: A masterclass of Mediterranean food!
text:
It was a spectacular gastronomic apprenticeship! We learned how to make sangria, potato omelettes, shrimp, and tomato bread. It was a master class! The tutors are very good at explaining, we were all able to practice, if you don't understand English they can even do the class in Spanish, Italian and Portuguese... The group was super friendly, fun and attentive, the facilities are super optimal, they have everything you need and more! 
The facilities are comfortable, and very complete! the tranquility that is in them is unheard of! I am very happy with my culinary classes
author: 717urielt
